description: This file contains the implementation of server and device endpoints, socket setup, and RPC communication logic for the Android Cuttlefish frontend, including socket creation, HTTP route handlers, WebSocket handling, and gRPC interactions within the operator package.
external_methods: generic networking and HTTP handler functions

classes.name: wsIoWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper struct that implements io.ReadWriteCloser for websocket connections to facilitate ADB proxying.

methods.name: createUnixSocketEndpoint
methods.description: Creates and binds a Unix socket at the specified path, setting permissions to restrict access.

methods.name: SetupDeviceEndpoint
methods.description: Sets up a Unix socket endpoint for devices, returning a function to listen and accept device connections.

methods.name: SetupControlEndpoint
methods.description: Sets up a Unix socket endpoint for server control, returning a listener function.

methods.name: CreateHttpHandlers
methods.description: Creates and configures HTTP route handlers for various API endpoints including device management, services, openwrt access, and polling.

methods.name: controlEndpoint
methods.description: Handles control messages over a Unix socket, specifically pre-registration messages.

methods.name: PreRegister
methods.description: Handles pre-registration of devices, manages registration states, and communicates status updates to clients.

methods.name: deviceEndpoint
methods.description: Handles device connection, registration, and message forwarding over a Unix socket.

methods.name: grpcListServices
methods.description: Calls gRPC to list services on a specific device.

methods.name: grpcListMethods
methods.description: Calls gRPC to list methods for a service on a device.

methods.name: grpcListReqResType
methods.description: Calls gRPC to list request/response types for a method.

methods.name: grpcCallUnaryMethod
methods.description: Performs a unary gRPC method call with JSON payload.

methods.name: grpcTypeInformation
methods.description: Retrieves type information via gRPC for a given service and type.

methods.name: openwrt
methods.description: Proxy HTTP requests to the device's OpenWRT interface via reverse proxy.

methods.name: adbProxy
methods.description: Sets up a WebSocket proxy for ADB communication between client and device.

methods.name: wsIoWrapper.Read
methods.description: Implements reading from websocket connection, fetching chunks of data.

methods.name: wsIoWrapper.Write
methods.description: Implements writing data to websocket connection.

methods.name: wsIoWrapper.Close
methods.description: Closes the websocket connection.

methods.name: listGroups
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to list device groups.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to list devices, optionally filtered by groupId.

methods.name: deviceInfo
methods.description: Returns detailed device info for a given deviceId.

methods.name: deviceFiles
methods.description: Serves device files, potentially with interception via a callback.

methods.name: createPolledConnection
methods.description: Creates a new long-polling connection for device communication.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Forwards messages from clients to devices over a long-polling connection.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Retrieves messages for a long-polling connection from a device.

methods.name: adbProxy
methods.description: Proxies ADB connections over WebSocket to a device.
